name: Local Read
description: Read a document from the offline library by id, as returned by local_search. Long documents are paged: repeat the call with the offset printed at the end.

id.description: Result id from local_search, copied exactly

offset.description: Continue reading from this character offset

path.description: The SAME 'path' passed to local_search — required whenever that search used one, because an id only resolves inside the folder that produced it (the search output prints the call to make)

images.description: Deliver the article's images to the user's chat. Default: automatic on the first page only (max 3); true forces them on any page, false disables
